text:
Maria L.: Quick async check — roadmap gating for release 1.3. I posted the final spec in Confluence (link) and ran the end-to-end smoke locally. Main asks: 1) product signoff on the behavioral change in routing, 2) infra to confirm canary capacity, 3) docs + SDK call example. Can people ack and call out any obvious blockers? :eyes:

Dan C.: Acked. Reading the spec now — question on the fallback policy: are we changing to prefer cheaper variant or lowest-latency? That bit looked ambiguous to me.

Maria L.: Good catch. The intent is: prefer latency SLO first, cost second. I'll update the one-line in the spec to say that explicitly.

Ash P.: Infra side: canary capacity is fine for a 2hr window at peak qps we estimated. Need a pruning window for caches though; otherwise memory spikes.

Leo N.: Re: caching — we should add the 30s TTL for prefix cache you proposed earlier. Small risk but reduces mem pressure. Also pinging Eng Runtime for a quick review (cc @Sophie C.).

Sophie C.: On it. I'll skim the spec and leave inline comments. Also opened a tiny PR for an SDK example: https://git.internal/r/redwood/sdk-examples/pull/72 — includes streaming snippet.

Maria L.: Thanks — can we get signoff from product (Dan, me) + Sophie by EOD? If infra/eng runtime confirm canary + cache TTL then I'll schedule the canary tomorrow morning.

Dan C.: I can sign off once Sophie posts any blocking comments. Mostly fine from product POV.

Sophie C.: Left two non-blocking comments and one question about error semantics. If Ash confirms cache TTL behavior, I'm good to sign.

Ash P.: Confirming TTL 30s is applied on the prefix cache and we'll monitor mem growth in the canary. I'll add a short alert: `prefix_cache_mem > 75% -> pager` for the canary window.

Maria L.: Awesome. Plan: update spec to clarify fallback, merge SDK example (Sophie), infra will push canary config (Ash), product signoffs once Sophie confirms. Will post brief launch checklist after merges. Thanks team :rocket:

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued for canary window tomorrow 09:00-11:00 UTC. CI status: all green.

Leo N.: Minor follow-up — can we add a one-liner to the release notes about behavior change (customer-facing)? I'll draft it after the spec tweak.

Maria L.: Yes please. I'll include Leo's sentence in the release notes. If no further blocks by EOD I'll mark this as green and proceed with scheduling.

Dan C.: Sounds good.

Sophie C.: Signing off pending Ash's alert config being pushed.

Ash P.: Alert pushed, canary config in infra repo. Link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra-config/commit/ab12cd3

Maria L.: Marking this thread as ✅ — thanks all.
